_doc: CAD spec for T10 AMBER DROPPER BOTTLE hero. Layout from canonical target (tmp/discovery/T10_target.png, 838x1340). Amber glass dropper bottle with a GOLD/brass collar + black rubber bulb dropper cap. BRAND = AVID-RA (NOT Regenic|Lab): white label with the AVID-RA molecule logo + 'COMPLEX AMINO RESEARCH', product name (navy, 2 lines), size + 'Bottle', and a 'RESEARCH PURPOSES ONLY' footer. Sole SKU = ghk-cu-serum (S0 -> no badge). The pseudo-dose '30ML' is pack volume, not a strength -> suppress as a dose line. gpt_image_2 generative + reference; prompt defers to reference.

prompt_template: Photorealistic e-commerce hero render of an amber glass dropper bottle with a brushed-gold collar and black rubber bulb dropper cap. Match the attached reference image EXACTLY for bottle shape, amber glass, gold-and-black dropper cap, label shape and placement, the AVID-RA branding, materials and lighting — change ONLY the product name text. BACKGROUND seamless very-light warm grey, soft key top-left, bottle vertically centered, soft contact shadow. The white label keeps the AVID-RA molecule logo with 'AVID-RA' and 'COMPLEX AMINO RESEARCH' (do NOT change the brand), then the product name 'GHK-Cu Serum Plus' in navy (largest, may wrap two lines), then a small grey line with '30ml' at left and 'Bottle' at right, then a small letter-spaced grey footer 'RESEARCH PURPOSES ONLY'. This product is AVID-RA brand, NOT Regenic|Lab; there is NO schedule badge and NO dose/strength number. TYPOGRAPHY DISCIPLINE: replicate reference sizes/spacing exactly, do not enlarge, do not invent any dose or strength. No 'Novecy' or other third-party branding. Clean premium research-grade, sharp focus, sRGB. Portrait 838x1340.
